scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix frontend && npm run test --prefix backend -- --runInBand
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test --prefix mobile
scripts.mobile:check: npm run typecheck --prefix mobile && npm run lint --prefix mobile && npm run test --prefix mobile && npm run validate:config --prefix mobile
scripts.firebase:serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only hosting
scripts.firebase:deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
